# --- Model Function (Defines the ODE System) ---
```{r}
# --- Model Function (Defines the ODE System) ---
anthrax_model_ode <- function(t, state, params) {
  # Unpack states - ensure names match your initial_state_values exactly
  S_h <- state["S_h"]; I_h <- state["I_h"]; R_h <- state["R_h"]; 
  D_h_disease_cumulative <- state["D_h_disease_cumulative"]; Cum_I_h_human <- state["Cum_I_h"] 
  
  S_l <- state["S_l"]; I_l <- state["I_l"]; C_l <- state["C_l"]; 
  D_l_disease_cumulative_L <- state["D_l_disease_cumulative"]; Cum_I_l_livestock <- state["Cum_I_l"] 
  
  DeadL_Day1_for_spores <- state["DeadL_Day1_for_spores"]
  DeadL_Day2_for_spores <- state["DeadL_Day2_for_spores"]
  
  S_w <- state["S_w"]; I_w <- state["I_w"]; C_w <- state["C_w"]; 
  D_w_disease_cumulative_W <- state["D_w_disease_cumulative"]; Cum_I_w_wildlife <- state["Cum_I_w"] 
  
  # --- ADD THESE LINES ---
  DeadW_Day1_for_spores <- state["DeadW_Day1_for_spores"]
  DeadW_Day2_for_spores <- state["DeadW_Day2_for_spores"]
  # --- END OF ADDED LINES ---
  
  B <- state["B"]

  # Unpack parameters 
  beta_hl <- params$beta_hl; sigma_h <- params$sigma_h; cfr_h <- params$cfr_h
  psi_l <- params$psi_l; psi_w <- params$psi_w; LD50_env <- params$LD50_env; n_hill <- params$n_hill
  mu_l_disease <- params$mu_l_disease; gamma_l <- params$gamma_l
  mu_w_disease <- params$mu_w_disease; gamma_w <- params$gamma_w
  theta_spores <- params$theta_spores; delta_B <- params$delta_B; k_delay_spore <- params$k_delay_spore; delta_c <- params$delta_c
  N_y <- params$N_y; k_pred_l_per_hyena <- params$k_pred_l_per_hyena; k_pred_w_per_hyena <- params$k_pred_w_per_hyena
  # Hyena scavenging
  w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg <- params$w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg; mass_l <- params$mass_l; mass_w <- params$mass_w
  max_scav_frac_per_day <- params$max_scav_frac_per_day
  gamma_to_spores <- params$gamma_to_spores 

  # Ensure non-negative states 
  S_h <- max(0, S_h); I_h <- max(0, I_h); R_h <- max(0, R_h)
  S_l <- max(0, S_l); I_l <- max(0, I_l); C_l <- max(0, C_l)
  S_w <- max(0, S_w); I_w <- max(0, I_w); C_w <- max(0, C_w)
  B <- max(0, B)
  DeadL_Day1_for_spores <- max(0, DeadL_Day1_for_spores); DeadL_Day2_for_spores <- max(0, DeadL_Day2_for_spores)
  DeadW_Day1_for_spores <- max(0, DeadW_Day1_for_spores); DeadW_Day2_for_spores <- max(0, DeadW_Day2_for_spores)

  # --- Human Dynamics --- 
  new_I_h_flow = beta_hl * S_h * I_l 
  leave_I_h_flow = sigma_h * I_h
  recover_h_flow = (1 - cfr_h) * leave_I_h_flow
  death_h_disease_flow = cfr_h * leave_I_h_flow
  
  dS_h_dt = -new_I_h_flow
  dI_h_dt = new_I_h_flow - leave_I_h_flow
  dR_h_dt = recover_h_flow
  dD_h_disease_cumulative_dt = death_h_disease_flow 
  dCum_I_h_dt = new_I_h_flow 

  # --- Livestock Dynamics --- 
 
  dose_l = psi_l * B
  P_inf_l = ifelse(dose_l <= 0 || LD50_env <= 0, 0, (dose_l^n_hill) / (dose_l^n_hill + LD50_env^n_hill)) 
  if (is.nan(P_inf_l) || !is.finite(P_inf_l)) P_inf_l = 0 
  new_I_l_env_flow = S_l * P_inf_l
  dS_l_dt = -new_I_l_env_flow

  predation_I_l_flow = 0
  if (N_y > 0 && k_pred_l_per_hyena > 0 && I_l > 1e-9) { 
    if (k_pred_w_per_hyena > 0 && I_w > 1e-9) { 
      predation_I_l_flow = k_pred_l_per_hyena * N_y * (I_l / (I_l + I_w + 1e-9)) 
    } else { 
      predation_I_l_flow = k_pred_l_per_hyena * N_y 
    }
  }
  predation_I_l_flow = min(predation_I_l_flow, I_l) 
  
  death_l_disease_flow = mu_l_disease * I_l 
  recover_l_flow = gamma_l * I_l           
  
  total_outflow_I_l = death_l_disease_flow + recover_l_flow + predation_I_l_flow
  if (total_outflow_I_l > I_l && I_l > 1e-9) { 
      scale_factor_l = I_l / total_outflow_I_l
      death_l_disease_flow = death_l_disease_flow * scale_factor_l
      recover_l_flow = recover_l_flow * scale_factor_l
      predation_I_l_flow = predation_I_l_flow * scale_factor_l
  }

  dI_l_dt = new_I_l_env_flow - death_l_disease_flow - recover_l_flow - predation_I_l_flow
  dD_l_disease_cumulative_L_dt = death_l_disease_flow 
  dCum_I_l_dt_livestock = new_I_l_env_flow 

  # --- Wildlife Dynamics --- 
  dose_w = psi_w * B
  P_inf_w = ifelse(dose_w <= 0 || LD50_env <= 0, 0, (dose_w^n_hill) / (dose_w^n_hill + LD50_env^n_hill)) 
  if (is.nan(P_inf_w) || !is.finite(P_inf_w)) P_inf_w = 0 
  new_I_w_env_flow = S_w * P_inf_w
  dS_w_dt = -new_I_w_env_flow

  predation_I_w_flow = 0
  if (N_y > 0 && k_pred_w_per_hyena > 0 && I_w > 1e-9) { 
    if (k_pred_l_per_hyena > 0 && I_l > 1e-9) { 
      predation_I_w_flow = k_pred_w_per_hyena * N_y * (I_w / (I_l + I_w + 1e-9)) 
    } else { 
      predation_I_w_flow = k_pred_w_per_hyena * N_y
    }
  }
  predation_I_w_flow = min(predation_I_w_flow, I_w) 
  
  death_w_disease_flow = mu_w_disease * I_w 
  recover_w_flow = gamma_w * I_w           

  total_outflow_I_w = death_w_disease_flow + recover_w_flow + predation_I_w_flow
  if (total_outflow_I_w > I_w && I_w > 1e-9) { 
      scale_factor_w = I_w / total_outflow_I_w
      death_w_disease_flow = death_w_disease_flow * scale_factor_w
      recover_w_flow = recover_w_flow * scale_factor_w
      predation_I_w_flow = predation_I_w_flow * scale_factor_w
  }

  dI_w_dt = new_I_w_env_flow - death_w_disease_flow - recover_w_flow - predation_I_w_flow
  dD_w_disease_cumulative_W_dt = death_w_disease_flow 
  dCum_I_w_dt_wildlife = new_I_w_env_flow 

  # --- Carcass Dynamics & Scavenging ---
  total_carcass_biomass_scavenged_by_hyenas_potential = N_y * w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg
  biomass_C_l_available = C_l * mass_l
  biomass_C_w_available = C_w * mass_w
  total_biomass_C_available = biomass_C_l_available + biomass_C_w_available
  
  scavenged_l_num_rate = 0
  scavenged_w_num_rate = 0
  if (total_biomass_C_available > 1e-9 && total_carcass_biomass_scavenged_by_hyenas_potential > 0) {
    prop_biomass_from_l = ifelse(total_biomass_C_available < 1e-9, 0, biomass_C_l_available / total_biomass_C_available)
    scavenged_l_biomass_rate = total_carcass_biomass_scavenged_by_hyenas_potential * prop_biomass_from_l
    scavenged_l_num_rate = ifelse(mass_l < 1e-9, 0, scavenged_l_biomass_rate / mass_l)
    
    prop_biomass_from_w = ifelse(total_biomass_C_available < 1e-9, 0, biomass_C_w_available / total_biomass_C_available)
    scavenged_w_biomass_rate = total_carcass_biomass_scavenged_by_hyenas_potential * prop_biomass_from_w
    scavenged_w_num_rate = ifelse(mass_w < 1e-9, 0, scavenged_w_biomass_rate / mass_w)
  }
  
  scavenged_l_num_rate = min(scavenged_l_num_rate, C_l * max_scav_frac_per_day, C_l)
  scavenged_w_num_rate = min(scavenged_w_num_rate, C_w * max_scav_frac_per_day, C_w)

  flow_to_sporulation_L_flow = gamma_to_spores * C_l
  flow_to_sporulation_W_flow = gamma_to_spores * C_w
  
  decay_C_l_flow = delta_c * C_l
  decay_C_w_flow = delta_c * C_w

  total_outflow_C_l = flow_to_sporulation_L_flow + decay_C_l_flow + scavenged_l_num_rate
  if (total_outflow_C_l > C_l && C_l > 1e-9) {
      scale_factor_Cl = C_l / total_outflow_C_l
      flow_to_sporulation_L_flow = flow_to_sporulation_L_flow * scale_factor_Cl
      decay_C_l_flow = decay_C_l_flow * scale_factor_Cl
      scavenged_l_num_rate = scavenged_l_num_rate * scale_factor_Cl
  }
  
  total_outflow_C_w = flow_to_sporulation_W_flow + decay_C_w_flow + scavenged_w_num_rate
   if (total_outflow_C_w > C_w && C_w > 1e-9) {
      scale_factor_Cw = C_w / total_outflow_C_w
      flow_to_sporulation_W_flow = flow_to_sporulation_W_flow * scale_factor_Cw
      decay_C_w_flow = decay_C_w_flow * scale_factor_Cw
      scavenged_w_num_rate = scavenged_w_num_rate * scale_factor_Cw
  }

  dC_l_dt = death_l_disease_flow - flow_to_sporulation_L_flow - decay_C_l_flow - scavenged_l_num_rate
  dC_w_dt = death_w_disease_flow - flow_to_sporulation_W_flow - decay_C_w_flow - scavenged_w_num_rate

  # --- Carcass Delay for Sporulation ---
  dDeadL_Day1_for_spores_dt = flow_to_sporulation_L_flow - k_delay_spore * DeadL_Day1_for_spores
  dDeadL_Day2_for_spores_dt = k_delay_spore * DeadL_Day1_for_spores - k_delay_spore * DeadL_Day2_for_spores
  
  dDeadW_Day1_for_spores_dt = flow_to_sporulation_W_flow - k_delay_spore * DeadW_Day1_for_spores # Uses DeadW_Day1_for_spores
  dDeadW_Day2_for_spores_dt = k_delay_spore * DeadW_Day1_for_spores - k_delay_spore * DeadW_Day2_for_spores # Uses DeadW_Day1_for_spores and DeadW_Day2_for_spores

  # --- Spore Dynamics --- 
  spore_input_rate_from_L_carcasses = theta_spores * (k_delay_spore * DeadL_Day2_for_spores)
  spore_input_rate_from_W_carcasses = theta_spores * (k_delay_spore * DeadW_Day2_for_spores) # Uses DeadW_Day2_for_spores
  
  dB_dt = (spore_input_rate_from_L_carcasses + spore_input_rate_from_W_carcasses) - delta_B * B

  # Return derivatives in this exact order of initial_state_values
  return(list(c(dS_h_dt, dI_h_dt, dR_h_dt, dD_h_disease_cumulative_dt, dCum_I_h_dt, 
                dS_l_dt, dI_l_dt, dC_l_dt, dD_l_disease_cumulative_L_dt, dCum_I_l_dt_livestock, 
                dDeadL_Day1_for_spores_dt, dDeadL_Day2_for_spores_dt,
                dS_w_dt, dI_w_dt, dC_w_dt, dD_w_disease_cumulative_W_dt, dCum_I_w_dt_wildlife, 
                dDeadW_Day1_for_spores_dt, dDeadW_Day2_for_spores_dt, # These derivatives use the unpacked states
                dB_dt)))
}
```
#--- Define All Parameters, Initial Conditions, and Run Simulation ---
```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PART 1: DEFINE MODEL PARAMETERS
# =============================================================================
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Define Model Parameters to Match Targets from Literature
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# --- Pre-calculate values for the list ---

# -- Humans --
val_cfr_h <- 0.149                                  # Case‐fatality rate (14.9%) - Kisaakye et al. 2020; Tumusiime et al. 2025
val_duration_infection_h <- 14                      # Infection duration (days) - Kisaakye et al. 2020; Tumusiime et al. 2025
val_sigma_h <- 1 / val_duration_infection_h         # Recovery+death rate (day⁻¹)

# -- Livestock --
val_cfr_l <- 0.95                                   # Livestock case-fatality rate (95%) - Merck Vet Manual
val_duration_infection_l <- 2.5                     # Livestock average infection duration (days) - Merck Vet Manual (48-72 hrs)
val_sigma_l <- 1 / val_duration_infection_l         # Livestock total rate of leaving I_l (day⁻¹)
val_mu_l_disease <- val_cfr_l * (1 / val_duration_infection_l) # Livestock death rate from disease (day⁻¹)
val_gamma_l <- (1 - val_cfr_l) * (1 / val_duration_infection_l) # Livestock recovery rate (day⁻¹)
val_duration_illness_l <- 1 / val_mu_l_disease      # Effective time to death for fatal cases (days) = 1/mu_l_disease. Approx 2.63 days.

# -- Wildlife --
val_cfr_w <- 0.10                                   # Wildlife case-fatality rate (10%) - Muturi, et al: DOI 10.4269/ajtmh.18-0224
val_duration_infection_w <- 180                     # Wildlife average infection duration (days) - Based on 10% mortality in 180 days
val_sigma_w <- 1 / val_duration_infection_w         # Wildlife total rate of leaving I_w (day⁻¹)
val_mu_w_disease <- val_cfr_w * (1 / val_duration_infection_w) # Wildlife death rate from disease (day⁻¹)
val_gamma_w <- (1 - val_cfr_w) * (1 / val_duration_infection_w) # Wildlife recovery rate (day⁻¹)
val_duration_illness_w <- 1 / val_mu_w_disease      # Effective time to death for fatal cases (days) = 1/mu_w_disease. 180 days.

# -- Environmental Reservoir --
val_theta_spores <- 1e3                            # Spores per carcass - (Literature/Assumption was 1e10, reduced this to 1e3 to make model less sensitive as the model had a rapid die off of all livestock when this was set to 1e10)
val_carcass_sporulation_delay <- 2                  # Sporulation latency (days) - (Literature/Assumption)
val_num_delay_stages_spore <- 2                     # Number of delay compartments for sporulation
val_k_delay_spore <- val_num_delay_stages_spore / val_carcass_sporulation_delay # Transition rate (day⁻¹)
val_delta_B <- 0.005                                # Spore decay (day⁻¹) - (Literature/Assumption, e.g., ~200 day half-life)

# -- Carcass decay/removal --
val_delta_c <- 1/10                                 # Carcass natural decay rate (day⁻¹; 10‐day mean) - (Literature/Assumption)
val_max_scav_frac_per_day <- 1.0                    # Max fraction of a carcass type scavenged per day by all hyenas
val_gamma_to_spores <- 1.0                          # Rate C_l/C_w move to sporulation delay line (1/day) - (Assumption, fast transition)

# -- Hyena filter parameters --
val_w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg <- 2.61                # kg carcass/day/hyena (Sonawane et al. 2021)
val_mass_l <- 350                                   # Livestock carcass mass (kg) - (Assumption/Estimate)
val_mass_w <- 350                                   # Wildlife carcass mass (kg) - (Assumption/Estimate)
val_pred_rate_preferred <- 0.05                     # Preferred prey predation (day⁻¹) - (Assumption/Calibration Target Base)
val_pred_rate_general <- 0.025                      # Non‐preferred scavenging (day⁻¹) - (Assumption/Calibration Target Base)


# --- Now, create the params_const list using these pre-calculated values ---
params_const <- list(
  # — Humans —
  cfr_h                   = val_cfr_h,    # Case‐fatality rate (14.9%)
  duration_infection_h    = val_duration_infection_h,       # Infection duration (days)
  sigma_h                 = val_sigma_h,     # Recovery+death rate (day⁻¹)

  # — Transmission to calibrate —
  beta_hl                 = NA,       # livestock→human transmission coef

  # — Environmental exposure to calibrate —
  psi_l                   = NA,       # livestock soil ingestion (cm³/day)
  psi_w                   = NA,       # wildlife soil ingestion (cm³/day)

  # — Dose–response parameters —
  LD50_env                = 1e4,      # LD₅₀ in soil (spores/cm³) - Chosen value, literature LD50 can be higher (e.g., 1e7)
  n_hill                  = 1,        # Hill exponent

  # — Disease course in animals —
  # -- Livestock --
  cfr_l                   = val_cfr_l,    # Livestock case-fatality rate (95%) From Merck Vet Manual 
  duration_infection_l    = val_duration_infection_l, # Livestock average infection duration (days)
  sigma_l                 = val_sigma_l,  # Livestock total rate of leaving I_l (day⁻¹)
  mu_l_disease            = val_mu_l_disease, # Livestock death rate from disease (day⁻¹)
  gamma_l                 = val_gamma_l,  # Livestock recovery rate (day⁻¹)
  duration_illness_l      = val_duration_illness_l, # Effective time to death for fatal cases (days)

  # -- Wildlife --
  cfr_w                   = val_cfr_w,    # Wildlife case-fatality rate (10%), from Muturi et al.
  duration_infection_w    = val_duration_infection_w, # Wildlife average infection duration (days)
  sigma_w                 = val_sigma_w,  # Wildlife total rate of leaving I_w (day⁻¹)
  mu_w_disease            = val_mu_w_disease, # Wildlife death rate from disease (day⁻¹)
  gamma_w                 = val_gamma_w,  # Wildlife recovery rate (day⁻¹)
  duration_illness_w      = val_duration_illness_w, # Effective time to death for fatal cases (days)
  
  # — Environmental reservoir —
  theta_spores            = val_theta_spores,     # Spores per carcass
  carcass_sporulation_delay = val_carcass_sporulation_delay, # Sporulation latency (days)
  num_delay_stages_spore  = val_num_delay_stages_spore, # Number of delay compartments
  k_delay_spore           = val_k_delay_spore,    # Transition rate between sporulation delay stages (day⁻¹)
  delta_B                 = val_delta_B,          # Spore decay (day⁻¹)

  # — Carcass decay/removal —
  delta_c                 = val_delta_c,          # Carcass natural decay rate (day⁻¹)
  max_scav_frac_per_day   = val_max_scav_frac_per_day, # Max fraction scavenged/day
  gamma_to_spores         = val_gamma_to_spores,  # Rate C_l/C_w move to sporulation delay

  # — Hyena filter parameters —
  N_y                     = NA,       # Number of hyenas (scenario-defined or calibrated)
  k_pred_l_per_hyena      = NA,       # Predation rate of infected LIVEstock per hyena (scenario-defined)
  k_pred_w_per_hyena      = NA,       # Predation rate of infected WILDLIFE per hyena (scenario-defined)
  w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg = val_w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg, # kg carcass/day/hyena
  mass_l                  = val_mass_l,           # Livestock carcass mass (kg)
  mass_w                  = val_mass_w,           # Wildlife carcass mass (kg)
  pred_rate_preferred     = val_pred_rate_preferred, # Preferred prey predation (day⁻¹)
  pred_rate_general       = val_pred_rate_general  # Non‐preferred scavenging (day⁻¹)
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PART 2: DEFINE INITIAL CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================
# Total human population
total_human_pop <- 21575

# Total livestock population and vaccination adjustment
total_livestock_pop_given   <- 150000    # Total livestock (head)
total_livestock_pop  <- 150000 
vaccination_prop_livestock  <- 0.20      # Proportion of livestock vaccinated at time 0 of the outbreak
initial_susceptible_livestock <- total_livestock_pop_given * (1 - vaccination_prop_livestock)
                                  # Unvaccinated livestock entering the S_l compartment

#Total wildlife pop
total_wildlife_pop  <- 10915

# Pack all state variables into a named vector
initial_state_values <- c(
  # Humans (SIR)
  S_h                    = 21570,       # Susceptible humans
  I_h                    = 5,           # Initially infected humans, we start the sim with 5 infected humans
  R_h                    = 0,           # Initially recovered humans
  D_h_disease_cumulative = 0,           # Cumulative human deaths
  Cum_I_h                = 5,           # Cumulative human infections

  # Livestock (SI → carcasses)
  S_l                    = initial_susceptible_livestock,  # Susceptible (unvaccinated) livestock
  I_l                    = 1,            # Initially infected livestock, we start the sim with 10 infected livestock
  C_l                    = 0,            # Live carcass count (feed into spores)
  D_l_disease_cumulative = 0,            # Cumulative livestock deaths
  Cum_I_l                = 1,            # Cumulative livestock infections

  # Livestock carcass delay stages for sporulation
  DeadL_Day1_for_spores  = 1,            # Carcasses in delay stage 1, we start the sim with 1 livestock carcass in delay stage 1
  DeadL_Day2_for_spores  = 1,            # Carcasses in delay stage 2, we start the sim with 1 livestock carcass in delay stage 2

  # Wild herbivores (SI → carcasses)
  S_w                    = 10914,        # Susceptible wild herbivores
  I_w                    = 1,            # Initially infected wild herbivores, we start the sim with 15 infected wild herbivores
  C_w                    = 0,            # Wild herbivore carcass count
  D_w_disease_cumulative = 0,            # Cumulative wild herbivore deaths
  Cum_I_w                = 1,            # Cumulative wild herbivore infections

  # Wild carcass delay stages for sporulation
  DeadW_Day1_for_spores  = 1,            # Carcasses in delay stage 1, we start the sim with 1 wildlife carcass in delay stage 1
  DeadW_Day2_for_spores  = 1,            # Carcasses in delay stage 2, we start the sim with 1 wildlife carcass in delay stage 1

  # Environmental spores
  B                      = 10^3            # Initial spore load in environment (spores/cm³), i.e. 1,000 spores/cm³, this was set at this level to calibrate the model in order to keep attack rates for humans, livestock, and wildlife as close to values from the literature. Keep in mind, LD50 is 10^7 (spores/cm³)
)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PART 3: DEFINE ATTACK RATES AND CONCEPTUAL HAZARDS
# =============================================================================
# This chunk defines the target attack rates from literature and calculates
# intermediate values (like rho) needed for other conceptual chunks.
# This is the single source of truth for attack rates.

# --- 1. Define Target Attack Rates (for calibration) ---
# These are the final cumulative attack rates from literature that the model will be calibrated to.
target_AR_h <- 4.03  # Human attack rate: 4.03 per 1,000 people
target_AR_l <- 0.46  # Livestock attack rate: 0.46 per 1,000 cattle
target_AR_w <- 5.77  # Wildlife attack rate: 5.77 per 1,000 (This is an observed outcome, not a calibration target)

# --- 2. Calculate rho (ρ), the attack fraction per individual ---
# This is needed for the conceptual hazard calculation in the next chunk.
# rho = (Attack Rate per 1000) / 1000
rho_h <- target_AR_h / 1000
rho_l <- target_AR_l / 1000
rho_w <- target_AR_w / 1000

# --- 3. Conceptual Hazard Calculation ---
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Compute ρ, estimate c_hl from contact types (with source DOIs), 
#    and then contact × ρ (“hazard”) for each host
# ---------------------------------------------------------

# --- 1) Attack‐fraction ρ from outbreak data (cases / population) ---
# (This is now computed in the chunk above as rho_h, rho_l, rho_w)

# --- 2) Estimate human←livestock contact rate c_hl from three activities ---
#   • Daily milking/herding touches: 20–30/day 
#     (estimated from DOI:10.33552/AAHDS.2019.01.000522)
#   • Slaughter events: ≈0.5/day; Raw‐meat handling: ≈0.5/day 
#     (combined means from DOI:10.21203/rs.3.rs-5842512/v1)
touches_mean    <- (20 + 30) / 2    # = 25
butchering_mean <- 0.5             # mean slaughter events/day
prep_mean       <- 0.5             # mean raw‐meat handling events/day
c_hl <- touches_mean + butchering_mean + prep_mean
#      ≈ 25 + 0.5 + 0.5 = 26.0 contacts per person per day

# --- 3) Define environmental contact = soil ingestion rate (Turner et al. 2013) ---
soil_ingest_rate <- 1.5            # cm³ soil ingested per animal per day
c_env_l          <- soil_ingest_rate
c_env_w          <- soil_ingest_rate

# --- 4) Compute daily hazard = c × ρ for each host ---
# This chunk will now run correctly because rho_h, rho_l, and rho_w are defined.
hazard_human     <- c_hl    * rho_h   # human risk from livestock
hazard_livestock <- c_env_l * rho_l   # livestock risk from environment
hazard_wild      <- c_env_w * rho_w   # wildlife risk from environment

# --- 5) Store back into parameters list for use in the ODE ---
# Note: These are conceptual and not directly used by the calibrated ODE model,
# but we store them for completeness.
params_const$c_hl    <- c_hl
params_const$c_env_l <- c_env_l
params_const$c_env_w <- c_env_w

# --- 6) Print for verification ---
cat("Daily hazards (c × ρ):\n")
cat(sprintf(
  "  humans   = %.4g/day\n  livestock= %.4g/day\n  wildlife = %.4g/day\n",
  hazard_human, hazard_livestock, hazard_wild
))

```

```{r}
# --- Simulation Time---
times <- seq(from = 0, to = 180, by = 1)
scenarios <- list(
  `Scen 1: Predator Absence` = list(N_y = 0,   k_l_target = "none", k_w_target = "none"),
  `Scen 2: Carcass Focus (Small Clan N=20)` = list(N_y = 20,  k_l_target = "none", k_w_target = "none"),
  `Scen 3: Carcass Focus (Large Clan N=150)` = list(N_y = 150, k_l_target = "none", k_w_target = "none"),
  `Scen 4: Wild Herb Pref (Large Clan N=150)` = list(N_y = 150, k_l_target = "none", k_w_target = "preferred"),
  `Scen 5: Livestock Pref (Large Clan N=150)` = list(N_y = 150, k_l_target = "preferred", k_w_target = "none"),
  `Scen 6: Wild Herb Pref (Small Clan N=20)` = list(N_y = 20,  k_l_target = "none", k_w_target = "preferred"),
  `Scen 7: Livestock Pref (Small Clan N=20)` = list(N_y = 20,  k_l_target = "preferred", k_w_target = "none"),
  `Scen 8: No Prey Pref (Large Clan N=150)` = list(N_y = 150, k_l_target = "general", k_w_target = "general"),
  `Scen 9: No Prey Pref (Small Clan N=20)` = list(N_y = 20,  k_l_target = "general", k_w_target = "general"))
get_pred_rate <- function(target_str, p_const_obj) {
  if (target_str == "none") return(0); if (target_str == "preferred") return(p_const_obj$pred_rate_preferred)
  if (target_str == "general") return(p_const_obj$pred_rate_general); stop("Error: Unknown predation target string.")}

```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# PART 5: CALIBRATE AND RUN ALL SCENARIOS
# =============================================================================
# --- Calibrate Transmission Parameters (Where psi_l = psi_w) & Run All Scenarios ---

cat("\n\n--- Calibrating Transmission Parameters (Assuming psi_l = psi_w) ---\n")

# Modify params_const for calibration setup
params_for_calibration <- params_const 
params_for_calibration$psi_common <- NA 
params_for_calibration$psi_l <- NULL    
params_for_calibration$psi_w <- NULL    
if (is.null(params_for_calibration$gamma_to_spores)) { 
    params_for_calibration$gamma_to_spores <- 1.0 
}

# --- Objective Function for Calibration ---
objective_function_AR_psi_common <- function(param_value, param_name_to_set, 
                                             target_AR_val, initial_state_calib, 
                                             times_calib, params_template_calib, 
                                             population_for_AR_calc, cumulative_infections_col_name) {
  params_run <- params_template_calib
  if (param_name_to_set == "psi_common") {
    params_run[["psi_l"]] <- param_value 
    params_run[["psi_w"]] <- param_value
    params_run[["psi_common"]] <- param_value 
  } else {
    params_run[[param_name_to_set]] <- param_value 
  }
  
  baseline_scen_config <- scenarios$`Scen 1: Predator Absence`
  params_run$N_y <- baseline_scen_config$N_y
  params_run$k_pred_l_per_hyena <- get_pred_rate(baseline_scen_config$k_l_target, params_const) 
  params_run$k_pred_w_per_hyena <- get_pred_rate(baseline_scen_config$k_w_target, params_const)

  critical_params_for_ode <- c("beta_hl", "psi_l", "psi_w", "N_y", "k_pred_l_per_hyena", "k_pred_w_per_hyena", "gamma_to_spores") 
  if (any(sapply(params_run[critical_params_for_ode], is.null)) || any(is.na(unlist(params_run[critical_params_for_ode])))) {
    return(1e9)
  }

  sim_output_calib <- tryCatch({
    suppressWarnings(
      ode(y = initial_state_calib, times = times_calib, func = anthrax_model_ode, 
          parms = params_run, method="lsoda", maxsteps=200000) 
    )
  }, error = function(e) { NULL })
  
  if (is.null(sim_output_calib) || any(is.na(sim_output_calib))) {
    return(1e9) 
  }
  
  final_day_calib <- tail(as.data.frame(sim_output_calib), 1)
  if (!cumulative_infections_col_name %in% names(final_day_calib)) return(1e9)
  if (population_for_AR_calc <= 0) return(1e9)
  sim_AR_calib <- (final_day_calib[[cumulative_infections_col_name]] / population_for_AR_calc) * 1000
  return(sim_AR_calib - target_AR_val)
}

```

```{r}
# --- Calibration Order: 1. psi_common, then 2. beta_hl ---

# --- A. Calibrate psi_common FIRST ---
cat("\n--- A. Calibrating psi_common (with placeholder beta_hl) ---\n")
params_for_psi_calib_pass1 <- params_for_calibration 
params_for_psi_calib_pass1$beta_hl <- 1.5e-08 # Placeholder beta_hl for this step (value from previous successful beta_hl calib)

psi_common_lower_bound <- 1e-7   
psi_common_upper_bound <- 0.1    

val_at_lower_psi_common <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(psi_common_lower_bound, "psi_common", target_AR_l, initial_state_values, times, params_for_psi_calib_pass1, total_livestock_pop, "Cum_I_l") 
val_at_upper_psi_common <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(psi_common_upper_bound, "psi_common", target_AR_l, initial_state_values, times, params_for_psi_calib_pass1, total_livestock_pop, "Cum_I_l") 
cat(sprintf("Target Livestock AR: %.4f\n", target_AR_l))
cat(sprintf("Objective function for psi_common at initial lower bound (%g): %f (Simulated AR would be %.4f)\n", psi_common_lower_bound, val_at_lower_psi_common, val_at_lower_psi_common + target_AR_l))
cat(sprintf("Objective function for psi_common at initial upper bound (%g): %f (Simulated AR would be %.4f)\n", psi_common_upper_bound, val_at_upper_psi_common, val_at_upper_psi_common + target_AR_l))

psi_common_calibrated_val <- 0.001 

iter_count_psi <- 0
max_iter_bounds_psi <- 20 # Increased max iterations
while ((is.na(val_at_lower_psi_common) || is.na(val_at_upper_psi_common) || is.infinite(val_at_lower_psi_common) || is.infinite(val_at_upper_psi_common) || (val_at_lower_psi_common * val_at_upper_psi_common >= 0)) && iter_count_psi < max_iter_bounds_psi) {
  iter_count_psi <- iter_count_psi + 1
  if (val_at_lower_psi_common > 0) { 
    psi_common_upper_bound <- psi_common_lower_bound
    psi_common_lower_bound <- psi_common_lower_bound / 10
  } else if (val_at_upper_psi_common < 0) { 
    psi_common_lower_bound <- psi_common_upper_bound 
    psi_common_upper_bound <- psi_common_upper_bound * 5
     if (psi_common_upper_bound == 0 && psi_common_lower_bound == 0) psi_common_upper_bound <- 1e-5 # Kickstart if stuck at zero
  } else { 
     if(val_at_lower_psi_common >=0 && val_at_upper_psi_common >=0){ # Both positive
        psi_common_upper_bound <- (psi_common_lower_bound + psi_common_upper_bound) / 2 # Midpoint
        if(psi_common_upper_bound <= psi_common_lower_bound) psi_common_lower_bound <- psi_common_lower_bound / 2
     } else { # Both negative
        psi_common_upper_bound <- psi_common_upper_bound * 2 
     }
  }
   if (psi_common_upper_bound <= psi_common_lower_bound || psi_common_upper_bound > 100 || psi_common_lower_bound < 1e-12) { 
      break
  }
  val_at_lower_psi_common <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(psi_common_lower_bound, "psi_common", target_AR_l, initial_state_values, times, params_for_psi_calib_pass1, total_livestock_pop, "Cum_I_l") 
  val_at_upper_psi_common <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(psi_common_upper_bound, "psi_common", target_AR_l, initial_state_values, times, params_for_psi_calib_pass1, total_livestock_pop, "Cum_I_l") 
}

if (is.na(val_at_lower_psi_common) || is.na(val_at_upper_psi_common) || is.infinite(val_at_lower_psi_common) || is.infinite(val_at_upper_psi_common) || (val_at_lower_psi_common * val_at_upper_psi_common >= 0)) {
  cat("Calibration bounds issue for psi_common persists after attempts. Using placeholder.\n")
} else {
  calibration_result_psi_common <- tryCatch(uniroot(objective_function_AR_psi_common, interval = c(psi_common_lower_bound, psi_common_upper_bound),
            param_name_to_set = "psi_common", target_AR_val = target_AR_l, initial_state_calib = initial_state_values, 
            times_calib = times, params_template_calib = params_for_psi_calib_pass1, 
            population_for_AR_calc = total_livestock_pop, cumulative_infections_col_name = "Cum_I_l", tol = 1e-6),
            error = function(e) {message("uniroot error for psi_common: ", e$message); NULL})
  if (!is.null(calibration_result_psi_common) && !is.null(calibration_result_psi_common$root)) {
      psi_common_calibrated_val <- calibration_result_psi_common$root
      cat(sprintf("Successfully calibrated psi_common (Pass 1): %g\n", psi_common_calibrated_val))
  } else {
      cat("uniroot for psi_common failed despite bounds. Using placeholder.\n")
  }
}
params_for_calibration$psi_l <- psi_common_calibrated_val
params_for_calibration$psi_w <- psi_common_calibrated_val
params_for_calibration$psi_common <- psi_common_calibrated_val

# --- B. Calibrate beta_hl SECOND (using calibrated psi_common) ---
cat("\n--- B. Calibrating beta_hl (using now-set psi_common) ---\n")
params_for_beta_hl_calib <- params_for_calibration 

cat("Target Human AR: %.4f\n", target_AR_h)
beta_hl_lower_bound <- 1e-09 
beta_hl_upper_bound <- 1e-04 

val_at_lower_beta_hl <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(beta_hl_lower_bound, "beta_hl", target_AR_h, initial_state_values, times, params_for_beta_hl_calib, total_human_pop, "Cum_I_h") 
val_at_upper_beta_hl <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(beta_hl_upper_bound, "beta_hl", target_AR_h, initial_state_values, times, params_for_beta_hl_calib, total_human_pop, "Cum_I_h") 
cat(sprintf("Objective function for beta_hl at initial lower bound (%g): %f (Simulated AR would be %.4f)\n", beta_hl_lower_bound, val_at_lower_beta_hl, val_at_lower_beta_hl + target_AR_h))
cat(sprintf("Objective function for beta_hl at initial upper bound (%g): %f (Simulated AR would be %.4f)\n", beta_hl_upper_bound, val_at_upper_beta_hl, val_at_upper_beta_hl + target_AR_h))

beta_hl_calibrated_val <- 1e-7 

iter_count_beta <- 0 
max_iter_bounds_beta <- 20
while ((is.na(val_at_lower_beta_hl) || is.na(val_at_upper_beta_hl) || is.infinite(val_at_lower_beta_hl) || is.infinite(val_at_upper_beta_hl) || (val_at_lower_beta_hl * val_at_upper_beta_hl >= 0)) && iter_count_beta < max_iter_bounds_beta) {
  iter_count_beta <- iter_count_beta + 1
  if (val_at_lower_beta_hl > 0) { 
    beta_hl_upper_bound <- beta_hl_lower_bound 
    beta_hl_lower_bound <- beta_hl_lower_bound / 10
  } else if (val_at_upper_beta_hl < 0) { 
    beta_hl_lower_bound <- beta_hl_upper_bound 
    beta_hl_upper_bound <- beta_hl_upper_bound * 10 
     if (beta_hl_upper_bound == 0 && beta_hl_lower_bound == 0) beta_hl_upper_bound <- 1e-5 
  } else { 
     if(val_at_lower_beta_hl >=0 && val_at_upper_beta_hl >=0){
        beta_hl_upper_bound <- (beta_hl_lower_bound + beta_hl_upper_bound) / 2
        if(beta_hl_upper_bound <= beta_hl_lower_bound) beta_hl_lower_bound <- beta_hl_lower_bound / 2
     } else { 
        beta_hl_upper_bound <- beta_hl_upper_bound * 2
     }
  }
  if (beta_hl_upper_bound <= beta_hl_lower_bound || beta_hl_upper_bound > 1 || beta_hl_lower_bound < 1e-15) { 
      break
  }
  val_at_lower_beta_hl <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(beta_hl_lower_bound, "beta_hl", target_AR_h, initial_state_values, times, params_for_beta_hl_calib, total_human_pop, "Cum_I_h") 
  val_at_upper_beta_hl <- objective_function_AR_psi_common(beta_hl_upper_bound, "beta_hl", target_AR_h, initial_state_values, times, params_for_beta_hl_calib, total_human_pop, "Cum_I_h") 
}

if (is.na(val_at_lower_beta_hl) || is.na(val_at_upper_beta_hl) || is.infinite(val_at_lower_beta_hl) || is.infinite(val_at_upper_beta_hl) || (val_at_lower_beta_hl * val_at_upper_beta_hl >= 0) ) {
  cat("Calibration bounds issue for beta_hl persists after attempts. Using placeholder.\n")
} else {
  calibration_result_beta_hl <- tryCatch(uniroot(objective_function_AR_psi_common, interval = c(beta_hl_lower_bound, beta_hl_upper_bound),
            param_name_to_set = "beta_hl", target_AR_val = target_AR_h, initial_state_calib = initial_state_values, 
            times_calib = times, params_template_calib = params_for_beta_hl_calib, 
            population_for_AR_calc = total_human_pop, cumulative_infections_col_name = "Cum_I_h", tol = 1e-7), 
            error = function(e) {message("uniroot error for beta_hl: ", e$message); NULL})
  if (!is.null(calibration_result_beta_hl) && !is.null(calibration_result_beta_hl$root)) {
      beta_hl_calibrated_val <- calibration_result_beta_hl$root
      cat(sprintf("Successfully calibrated beta_hl: %g\n", beta_hl_calibrated_val))
  } else {
      cat("uniroot for beta_hl failed despite suitable bounds. Using placeholder.\n")
  }
}
params_for_calibration$beta_hl <- beta_hl_calibrated_val 

params_final_calibrated <- params_for_calibration
cat("\n--- Final Calibrated Parameters for Scenario Runs: ---\n")
cat(sprintf("beta_hl: %g, psi_common: %g, gamma_to_spores: %g\n", 
            params_final_calibrated$beta_hl, params_final_calibrated$psi_common, params_final_calibrated$gamma_to_spores))
```

```{r}
# --- Run Simulation for Each Scenario ---
cat("\n\n--- Running Simulations for All Scenarios ---\n")
results_all_scenarios <- list()

# FIX 1: Define the list of parameters the ODE function explicitly uses for validation.
# This variable was missing, causing an "object not found" error.
explicit_params_list_for_ode <- c(
  "beta_hl", "sigma_h", "cfr_h", "psi_l", "psi_w", "LD50_env", "n_hill", 
  "mu_l_disease", "gamma_l", "mu_w_disease", "gamma_w", "theta_spores", 
  "delta_B", "k_delay_spore", "delta_c", "N_y", "k_pred_l_per_hyena", 
  "k_pred_w_per_hyena", "w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg", "mass_l", "mass_w", 
  "max_scav_frac_per_day", "gamma_to_spores"
)

scen_names_to_run <- names(scenarios)

for (scen_name in scen_names_to_run) {
  cat("\n-------------------------------------------------------\n")
  cat("DEBUG: Preparing to run Scenario:", scen_name, "\n")
  current_scen_config <- scenarios[[scen_name]]
  
  params_scenario <- params_final_calibrated
  
  params_scenario$N_y <- current_scen_config$N_y
  k_l_val <- get_pred_rate(current_scen_config$k_l_target, params_const)
  k_w_val <- get_pred_rate(current_scen_config$k_w_target, params_const)
  params_scenario$k_pred_l_per_hyena <- k_l_val
  params_scenario$k_pred_w_per_hyena <- k_w_val
  
  if (!is.null(params_scenario$psi_common) && is.numeric(params_scenario$psi_common)) {
    params_scenario$psi_l <- params_scenario$psi_common
    params_scenario$psi_w <- params_scenario$psi_common
  } else {
    params_scenario$psi_l <- if (is.null(params_scenario$psi_l) || is.na(params_scenario$psi_l)) 0.01 else params_scenario$psi_l
    params_scenario$psi_w <- if (is.null(params_scenario$psi_w) || is.na(params_scenario$psi_w)) 0.01 else params_scenario$psi_w
  }
  
  na_params_in_scenario <- c()
  for (p_name in explicit_params_list_for_ode) {
    if (!p_name %in% names(params_scenario)) {
      na_params_in_scenario <- c(na_params_in_scenario, paste0(p_name, " (MISSING)"))
    } else {
      val <- params_scenario[[p_name]]
      if (is.null(val) || is.na(val) || is.infinite(val) || is.nan(val)) {
        na_params_in_scenario <- c(na_params_in_scenario, paste0(p_name, " (INVALID: ", val, ")"))
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (length(na_params_in_scenario) > 0) {
    message(sprintf("WARNING: Scenario '%s' has missing or invalid parameters:\n%s",
                    scen_name, paste(na_params_in_scenario, collapse = ", ")))
    sim_output <- NULL
  } else {
    sim_output <- tryCatch({
      ode(y = initial_state_values, times = times, func = anthrax_model_ode,
          parms = params_scenario, method = "lsoda", maxsteps = 500000)
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(sprintf("  ODE solver error for scenario '%s': %s", scen_name, e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })
  }
  # DEBUG: Removed the stray `return(NULL)` and extra `}` that were here, which caused a syntax error.
  
  if (is.null(sim_output) || any(is.na(sim_output))) {
    col_names_output <- c("time", names(initial_state_values))
    dummy_df <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = length(times), ncol = length(col_names_output)))
    colnames(dummy_df) <- col_names_output
    dummy_df$time <- times
    results_all_scenarios[[scen_name]] <- dummy_df
  } else {
    results_all_scenarios[[scen_name]] <- as.data.frame(sim_output)
  }
}
cat("All scenario simulations complete.\n")

# --- Output Calculated Attack Rates from Simulations ---
cat("\n--- Calculated Attack Rates (per 1,000 population) at Day", max(times), " ---\n")
attack_rates_summary <- data.frame(Scenario=character(), N_y=numeric(), Human_AR=numeric(), Livestock_AR=numeric(), WildHerb_AR=numeric(), Final_B=numeric(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
for (scen_name in names(results_all_scenarios)) {
  final_day_data <- tail(results_all_scenarios[[scen_name]], 1)
  AR_h_sim <- if(nrow(final_day_data)==0 || !("Cum_I_h" %in% names(final_day_data)) || all(is.na(final_day_data$Cum_I_h))) NA else (final_day_data$Cum_I_h / total_human_pop) * 1000
  AR_l_sim <- if(nrow(final_day_data)==0 || !("Cum_I_l" %in% names(final_day_data)) || all(is.na(final_day_data$Cum_I_l))) NA else (final_day_data$Cum_I_l / total_livestock_pop) * 1000
  AR_w_sim <- if(nrow(final_day_data)==0 || !("Cum_I_w" %in% names(final_day_data)) || all(is.na(final_day_data$Cum_I_w))) NA else (final_day_data$Cum_I_w / total_wildlife_pop) * 1000
  final_B_val <- if(nrow(final_day_data)==0 || !("B" %in% names(final_day_data)) || all(is.na(final_day_data$B))) NA else final_day_data$B
  current_N_y <- scenarios[[scen_name]]$N_y
  cat(sprintf("Scen: %s (N_y=%d) H_AR:%.2f L_AR:%.2f W_AR:%.2f B:%.1e\n", scen_name, current_N_y, AR_h_sim, AR_l_sim, AR_w_sim, final_B_val))
  attack_rates_summary <- rbind(attack_rates_summary, data.frame(Scenario=scen_name, N_y=current_N_y, Human_AR=AR_h_sim, Livestock_AR=AR_l_sim, WildHerb_AR=AR_w_sim, Final_B=final_B_val))
}
cat("\nSummary of simulated Attack Rates stored in 'attack_rates_summary'.\n")

# --- Generate Plots for Each Scenario (Individual Dynamics) ---
cat("\n--- Generating Plots for Each Scenario (Displaying in R Environment using ggplot2) ---\n")
create_placeholder_plot <- function(title_text) {
  ggplot() + annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = paste("Data error or NAs for:\n", title_text), size = 5, hjust = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title_text) + theme_void() 
}

for (scen_name in names(results_all_scenarios)) {
  cat("Plotting for:", scen_name, "\n")
  df_plot_wide <- results_all_scenarios[[scen_name]]
  
  if(is.null(df_plot_wide) || !is.data.frame(df_plot_wide) || nrow(df_plot_wide) == 0 || all(sapply(df_plot_wide, function(col) all(is.na(col)))) ) {
      cat("  Skipping plots for scenario '", scen_name, "' due to missing, empty, or all NA data (likely ODE failure).\n")
      if (interactive()) {
        try(print(create_placeholder_plot(paste("All data NA for scenario:", scen_name))), silent=TRUE)
      }
      next 
  }

  plot_list_p1 <- list() 
  plot_list_p2 <- list() 
  plot_list_p3 <- list() 

  # Page 1 Plots
  plot_list_p1$p1a <- tryCatch({ 
    if (!"S_h" %in% names(df_plot_wide) || all(is.na(df_plot_wide$S_h))) stop("Column S_h missing or all NA")
    ggplot(df_plot_wide, aes(x = time, y = S_h)) + geom_line(color = "blue") +
      labs(title = "Susceptible Humans (S_h)", x = "Time (days)", y = "Number") + theme_minimal() + ylim(0, NA)
  }, error = function(e) { create_placeholder_plot(paste("S_h\nError:", e$message)) })
  
  plot_list_p1$p1b <- tryCatch({ 
    if (!all(c("time", "I_h", "R_h") %in% names(df_plot_wide))) stop("time, I_h or R_h missing")
    df_human_IR <- df_plot_wide %>% dplyr::select(time, I_h, R_h) %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -time, names_to = "Compartment", values_to = "Count")
    if(nrow(df_human_IR) == 0 || all(is.na(df_human_IR$Count))) stop("Empty/NA data Human I_h, R_h")
    ggplot(df_human_IR, aes(x = time, y = Count, color = Compartment)) + geom_line() +
```

```{r}
# --- Generate Summary Table for Specific Time Points ---
cat("\n--- Generating Summary Table of Infections, Deaths, and Spore Count ---\n")

# Target time points for the report
report_times <- c(0, 50, 100, 180)

# Define required columns for selection and their desired names in the table
vars_to_select_and_rename <- c(
  Time = "time",
  `Human Infections (Cum.)` = "Cum_I_h",
  `Human Deaths (Cum.)` = "D_h_disease_cumulative",
  `Livestock Infections (Cum.)` = "Cum_I_l",
  `Livestock Deaths (Cum.)` = "D_l_disease_cumulative",
  `Wildlife Infections (Cum.)` = "Cum_I_w",
  `Wildlife Deaths (Cum.)` = "D_w_disease_cumulative",
  `Spore Count (B)` = "B"
)
placeholder_col_names <- names(vars_to_select_and_rename)[names(vars_to_select_and_rename) != "Time"]

# Initialize an empty list to store data frames for each scenario
all_scenarios_summary_list <- list()

# Loop through each scenario's results
for (scen_name in names(results_all_scenarios)) {
  df_scen_results <- results_all_scenarios[[scen_name]]

  if (!is.data.frame(df_scen_results) || nrow(df_scen_results) == 0) {
    summary_for_scenario <- data.frame(Scenario = scen_name, Time = report_times)
    for (col_name in placeholder_col_names) {
      summary_for_scenario[[col_name]] <- NA_real_
    }
    summary_for_scenario <- summary_for_scenario %>% 
        dplyr::select(Scenario, all_of(names(vars_to_select_and_rename))) 
    all_scenarios_summary_list[[scen_name]] <- summary_for_scenario
    next
  }
  
  df_at_report_times <- df_scen_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(time %in% report_times) 

  source_cols_needed <- unname(vars_to_select_and_rename[names(vars_to_select_and_rename) != "Time"])
  
  if (nrow(df_at_report_times) > 0 && 
      all(source_cols_needed %in% names(df_at_report_times)) &&
      sum(!is.na(df_at_report_times[, source_cols_needed, drop = FALSE])) > 0) {
    summary_for_scenario <- df_at_report_times %>%
      dplyr::select(all_of(vars_to_select_and_rename)) %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(Scenario = scen_name, .before = 1)    
  } else {
    summary_for_scenario <- data.frame(Scenario = scen_name, Time = report_times)
    for (col_name in placeholder_col_names) {
      summary_for_scenario[[col_name]] <- NA_real_
    }
    summary_for_scenario <- summary_for_scenario %>% 
        dplyr::select(Scenario, all_of(names(vars_to_select_and_rename)))
  }
  all_scenarios_summary_list[[scen_name]] <- summary_for_scenario
}

# Combine all scenario summaries into one data frame
final_summary_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_scenarios_summary_list) 

# Define digit format for kable
digits_vector <- c(NA, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0)

# Display the table using kable and kableExtra
if (nrow(final_summary_table) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(final_summary_table, 
        caption = "Summary of Cumulative Infections, Cumulative Deaths, and Environmental Spore Count at Specific Time Points",
        digits = digits_vector,
        format.args = list(big.mark = ","), 
        booktabs = TRUE,
        row.names = FALSE) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), 
                  full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 9) %>% 
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>% 
    kableExtra::collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
    kableExtra::footnote(general = "Infections and Deaths are cumulative totals since the start of the outbreak. Spore Count (B) is in spores/cm³.",
             general_title = "Note:",
             footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
             escape = FALSE)
}
```

#---Sensitivity analysis on parameters
```{r}
# --- Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis ---

cat("\n\n--- Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis (50 Replicates per Scenario) ---\n")
set.seed(123) # Set seed for reproducibility

if (!exists("params_final_calibrated")) stop("Error: 'params_final_calibrated' not found.")

num_replicates_mc <- 50

# Define parameters to vary and their perturbation range (as proportion of baseline)
mc_params_perturb_info <- list(
  "LD50_env" = 0.20,                 # Baseline +/- 20%
  "theta_spores" = 0.20,             # Baseline +/- 20%
  "w_carcass_hyena_daily_kg" = 0.20, # Baseline +/- 20%
  "gamma_to_spores" = 0.20,          # Baseline +/- 20%
  "delta_B" = 0.20,                  # Baseline +/- 20% (Example of adding another)
  "beta_hl" = 0.10,                  # Baseline +/- 10%
  "psi_common" = 0.10                # Baseline +/- 10%
)

# Store all Monte Carlo SA results
monte_carlo_results_all_scenarios <- list()

# Loop through each of your 9 main scenarios
for (scen_name_main in names(scenarios)) {
  cat("\n--- Running Monte Carlo SA for Main Scenario:", scen_name_main, "---\n")
  
  main_scen_config <- scenarios[[scen_name_main]]
  
  params_scenario_baseline <- params_final_calibrated 
  params_scenario_baseline$N_y <- main_scen_config$N_y
  params_scenario_baseline$k_pred_l_per_hyena <- get_pred_rate(main_scen_config$k_l_target, params_const)
  params_scenario_baseline$k_pred_w_per_hyena <- get_pred_rate(main_scen_config$k_w_target, params_const)

  replicates_output_list <- vector("list", num_replicates_mc)

  for (i in 1:num_replicates_mc) {
    if (i %% 10 == 0) cat("  MC Replicate:", i, "of", num_replicates_mc, "for", scen_name_main, "\n")
    
    params_replicate <- params_scenario_baseline
    perturbed_values_this_replicate <- list()

    for (param_name in names(mc_params_perturb_info)) {
      baseline_val <- params_scenario_baseline[[param_name]]
      perturb_fraction <- mc_params_perturb_info[[param_name]]
      
      if (is.null(baseline_val)) {
        next
      }
      
      lower_bound_perturb <- baseline_val * (1 - perturb_fraction)
      upper_bound_perturb <- baseline_val * (1 + perturb_fraction)
      perturbed_val <- runif(1, min = lower_bound_perturb, max = upper_bound_perturb)
      perturbed_val <- max(0, perturbed_val)
      
      params_replicate[[param_name]] <- perturbed_val
      perturbed_values_this_replicate[[param_name]] <- perturbed_val

      if (param_name == "psi_common") {
        params_replicate$psi_l <- perturbed_val
        params_replicate$psi_w <- perturbed_val
      }
    }
    
    sim_output_mc_rep <- tryCatch({
      ode(y = initial_state_values, times = times, func = anthrax_model_ode, 
          parms = params_replicate, method="lsoda", maxsteps=500000)
    }, error = function(e) { NULL })
    
    if(is.null(sim_output_mc_rep)){
        final_day_mc_rep <- data.frame(Cum_I_h=NA, Cum_I_l=NA, Cum_I_w=NA, B=NA)
    } else {
        final_day_mc_rep <- tail(as.data.frame(sim_output_mc_rep), 1)
    }
    
    replicate_data <- data.frame(
        replicate_num = i,
        Cum_I_h = final_day_mc_rep$Cum_I_h,
        Cum_I_l = final_day_mc_rep$Cum_I_l,
        Cum_I_w = final_day_mc_rep$Cum_I_w,
        Final_B = final_day_mc_rep$B
    )
    for(p_name in names(perturbed_values_this_replicate)){
        replicate_data[[paste0("perturbed_", p_name)]] <- perturbed_values_this_replicate[[p_name]]
    }
    replicates_output_list[[i]] <- replicate_data
  }
  
  monte_carlo_results_all_scenarios[[scen_name_main]] <- do.call(rbind, replicates_output_list)
}
cat("\n\n--- Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis Runs Complete ---\n")
```
#--- Summarize and Visualize Monte Carlo SA Results ---
```{r}
mc_summary_tables_list <- list()
all_scenarios_mc_summary_df <- data.frame()

cat("\n\n--- Summarizing Monte Carlo SA Results ---\n")

for (scen_name_main in names(monte_carlo_results_all_scenarios)) {
  scenario_mc_data <- monte_carlo_results_all_scenarios[[scen_name_main]]
  
  if(is.null(scenario_mc_data) || nrow(scenario_mc_data) == 0) {
      next
  }
  
  if (all(is.na(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h)) && all(is.na(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l)) && all(is.na(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w)) && all(is.na(scenario_mc_data$Final_B))) {
      summary_stats_for_scenario <- data.frame(
          Scenario = scen_name_main, Outcome = c("Cum_I_h", "Cum_I_l", "Cum_I_w", "Final_B"),
          Mean = NA, Median = NA, P025 = NA, P975 = NA, N_successful_runs = 0
      )
      all_scenarios_mc_summary_df <- rbind(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df, summary_stats_for_scenario)
      next
  }

  safe_quantile <- function(x, probs, na.rm = TRUE) { if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else quantile(x, probs = probs, na.rm = na.rm) }
  safe_mean <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE) { if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else mean(x, na.rm = na.rm) }
  safe_median <- function(x, na.rm = TRUE) { if (all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else median(x, na.rm = na.rm) }

  summary_stats_for_scenario <- data.frame(
    Scenario = scen_name_main,
    Outcome = c("Cum_I_h", "Cum_I_l", "Cum_I_w", "Final_B"),
    Mean = c(safe_mean(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h), safe_mean(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l), safe_mean(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w), safe_mean(scenario_mc_data$Final_B)),
    Median = c(safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Final_B)),
    P025 = c(safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Final_B, 0.025)),
    P975 = c(safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Final_B, 0.975)),
    N_successful_runs = sum(!is.na(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h)) 
  )
  
  all_scenarios_mc_summary_df <- rbind(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df, summary_stats_for_scenario)

  plot_data_mc_long <- scenario_mc_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Cum_I_h, Cum_I_l, Cum_I_w, Final_B) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Outcome_Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) 

  if(nrow(plot_data_mc_long) > 0) {
      p_mc_density <- ggplot(plot_data_mc_long, aes(x = Value)) +
        geom_density(aes(fill = Outcome_Variable), alpha = 0.5) +
        facet_wrap(~ Outcome_Variable, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = paste("Outcome Distributions from MC SA for:", scen_name_main), x = "Outcome Value", y = "Density") +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face="bold"), strip.text = element_text(face="bold"))
      
      print(p_mc_density)
  }
}

cat("\n\n--- Combined Monte Carlo SA Summary Table ---\n")
if (nrow(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df) > 0) {
    cols_to_round <- c("Mean", "Median", "P025", "P975")
    all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display <- all_scenarios_mc_summary_df
    all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display[cols_to_round] <- lapply(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display[cols_to_round], round, digits = 2)

    print(
      kable(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display, 
            caption = "Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis Summary for All Scenarios", 
            format = "pipe",
            align = 'lrrrrr') %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
        group_rows(index = table(factor(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display$Scenario, levels = names(scenarios))))
    )
}
```

```{r}
    Median = c(safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w), safe_median(scenario_mc_data$Final_B)),
    P025 = c(safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w, 0.025), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Final_B, 0.025)),
    P975 = c(safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_l, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_w, 0.975), safe_quantile(scenario_mc_data$Final_B, 0.975)),
    N_successful_runs = sum(!is.na(scenario_mc_data$Cum_I_h)) 
  )
  
  all_scenarios_mc_summary_df <- rbind(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df, summary_stats_for_scenario)

  # --- START OF EDITS TO MAKE PLOTS VISUALLY PLEASING ---
  # 1. RENAME FACET HEADERS: We modify the 'Outcome_Variable' column before plotting.
  # We convert it to a factor and provide new, more descriptive labels.
  # The \n creates a line break for the long label.
  plot_data_mc_long <- scenario_mc_data %>%
    dplyr::select(Cum_I_h, Cum_I_l, Cum_I_w, Final_B) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Outcome_Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Outcome_Variable = factor(Outcome_Variable,
        levels = c("Cum_I_h", "Cum_I_l", "Cum_I_w", "Final_B"),
        labels = c("Cumulative Human Cases", 
                   "Cumulative Livestock Cases", 
                   "Cumulative Wild Herbivore Cases", 
                   "Environmental Spore Load\n(spores/cm³)")
    ))

  if(nrow(plot_data_mc_long) > 0) {
      p_mc_density <- ggplot(plot_data_mc_long, aes(x = Value)) +
        geom_density(aes(fill = Outcome_Variable), alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
        facet_wrap(~ Outcome_Variable, scales = "free") +
        # 2. RENAME PLOT TITLE: The title is updated to your requested format.
        labs(
          title = paste("Distributions for MCSA for", scen_name_main), 
          x = "Outcome Value", 
          y = "Density"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        # 3. REDUCE TEXT SIZE: We specify sizes for all key text elements.
        theme(
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9), # Facet headers
          axis.title = element_text(size = 10), # X and Y axis titles
          axis.text = element_text(size = 8)   # X and Y axis tick labels
        )
      # --- END OF EDITS ---
      
      print(p_mc_density)
  }
}

cat("\n\n--- Combined Monte Carlo SA Summary Table ---\n")
if (nrow(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df) > 0) {
    cols_to_round <- c("Mean", "Median", "P025", "P975")
    all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display <- all_scenarios_mc_summary_df
    all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display[cols_to_round] <- lapply(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display[cols_to_round], round, digits = 2)

    print(
      kable(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display, 
            caption = "Monte Carlo Sensitivity Analysis Summary for All Scenarios", 
            format = "pipe",
            align = 'lrrrrr') %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"), full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10) %>%
        group_rows(index = table(factor(all_scenarios_mc_summary_df_display$Scenario, levels = names(scenarios))))
    )
}
```
